description: CNCjs is a web-based interface for CNC milling controller running Grbl, Smoothieware, or TinyG. Connecting to the CNC machine over a serial connection using a USB serial port or a Serial-to-WiFi module like XBee or USR-WIFI232-T.
author: JustSerdar

tips.before_install:
Make sure your CNC machine is connected via USB and the correct port is mapped in the devices section.
For more information, visit: https://github.com/cncjs/cncjs/blob/master/README.md

title: CNCjs
